email.subject1: a signal play for Magic Software
email.body1:
Dan, saw Magic Software closed its merger with Matrix IT in February.

A merger that size usually opens more enterprise accounts and cross-sell motion than the team can cover before the integration settles, and that is where good deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Magic Software off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dan, quick follow-up for Magic Software.

Post-merger, enterprise pipeline targets usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Magic Software needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dan, last bit of proof for Magic Software.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Magic Software's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after a merger, and I know integration is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise software motion? I will tailor it to Magic Software either way.
